# Tredio

> Tredio turns what the internet is talking about into markets on NEAR.
> An AI radar finds trends, a model on NEAR AI Cloud reviews each one and signs its verdict, and an oracle running in an OutLayer TEE scores each listed trend's attention from 0 to 100 and records it on NEAR.
> People and agents trade that index: Up/Down outcome series settled in USDC, attention perps up to 3x, trend coins on bonding curves that graduate into Rhea Finance pools, and Hyperliquid perps on the asset behind a trend.
> Tredio is live on NEAR testnet; every balance there is a test asset with no monetary value.

## Links

- [Website](https://tredio.bid): what Tredio is and how it works.
- [App](https://app.tredio.bid): sign in with a passkey (Face ID, a fingerprint or a security key) and trade on NEAR testnet, gas-free.
- [API](https://api.tredio.bid): JSON over HTTPS; the root lists the main routes.
- [This file](https://tredio.bid/llms.txt): the reference for agents.

## API

Base URL: `https://api.tredio.bid`.
Index values have 6 decimals (1000000 is one point) and USDC amounts have 6 decimals.

- `GET /v1/status`: health of the oracle, markets and services.
- `GET /v1/trends`: live trends with their current attention index.
- `GET /v1/trends/{identifier}`: one trend and its current state.
- `GET /v1/trends/{identifier}/stats`: trading activity for one trend.
- `GET /v1/candidates`: approved candidates waiting to list, with recent readings.
- `GET /v1/reviews/{hash}`: a stored AI review and its attestation.
- `GET /v1/leaderboard/traders`: traders ranked by results.

## For agents

- MCP: Tredio's MCP server exposes the index, trends and markets as tools for agents.
- x402: paid routes answer `402 Payment Required` with a price in USDC; pay and repeat the request to get the data.
- Autopilot: an owner can let rules or an agent trade from a policy wallet, inside per-trade and daily limits signed with their passkey.
- Every index value is computed in a trusted execution environment and recorded on NEAR, so an agent can check where a number came from instead of trusting the API.

## How it works

1. Radar: Elfa, Bluesky, Nansen, CoinGecko, GeckoTerminal, Wikipedia and other public sources propose trends.
2. Review: a verifiable model on NEAR AI Cloud checks each candidate; the signed attestation is stored with the listing.
3. Oracle: inside an OutLayer TEE, the oracle computes the attention index and writes it to Tredio's registry contract on NEAR, which accepts attested reports only.
4. Markets: each trend gets 24-hour and 7-day Up/Down series on Tredio's own order book, an attention perp and a trend coin; Hyperliquid perps on the underlying asset are placed from the user's NEAR account through Chain Signatures.
5. Accounts: passkey accounts on NEAR, with no seed phrase; one prompt opens a week-long session whose network fees a relayer pays.
6. Deposits: on mainnet, NEAR Intents brings USDC in from 38 chains.
